name: Genesis Block
summary: The first block of the Bitcoin blockchain, mined by Satoshi Nakamoto with the message "The Times 03/Jan/2009 Chancellor on brink of second bailout for banks". Established the 50 BTC block reward and 10-minute block target.
summaryZh: 比特币区块链的第一个区块，由中本聪挖出，区块中记录了《泰晤士报》头版标题。确立了50 BTC的区块奖励和10分钟出块目标。
